title: paspalum canarae
intro: Paspalum canarae, commonly known as Bengal grass, is a type of perennial grass native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its use in treating digestive issues and its potential anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum canarae are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects. Further studies are required to confirm the bioactive constituents and potential health benefits of Paspalum canarae.
